name: Historic District Streetscape in Xuzhou: Three Pairwise Comparisons
description:
Method replication: participants compare pairs of street views from the Pengcheng Qili historic district of Xuzhou on three questions (cultural character, spatial order, visual comfort), choosing one image or "Difficult to judge"; the images are not the paper's stimuli (94 re-fetched Baidu street views, one of four cardinal directions per point, 2016–2022).

Original study: Li, Chen, Liao, Sun & Liu (2026), Land 15(9), 1640. Baidu street views (mainly 2022) in four directions at 2243 points every 50 m along the district's streets; 910 representative images were compared in pairs by 71 volunteers (34 women, 37 men; mostly architecture students plus local residents) in a Streamlit tool, 100 comparisons per dimension, with a "difficult to judge" option that was dropped from the Bradley–Terry scores. ResNet50 models then mapped the three perceptions across the district.

Differences from the original study: (1) 94 newly fetched Baidu views from the old city around Hubushan, Huanglou Park and Kuaizaiting Park instead of the authors' 910 images; (2) 30 comparisons per dimension instead of 100; (3) the three questions run one after another in one survey; the deep learning models and spatial statistics are not part of the survey.
author: Li, Chen, Liao, Sun & Liu
